fullText.simplified:
二、我要去沉睡了

    多多二十七岁的这一年——其实就是今年，阿乐离开了我们。那天早上，阿乐坐空中飞车去学校，但空中飞车的数据库发生问题，两个空中飞车在空中相撞了。两个飞车上共有七个人，这七人和相撞的飞车同时从高空掉下，有三人因为伤太重去世了。这三人里有阿乐。阿乐去世后的那个星期，我每天都在家照顾多多，因为多多太难过了。
    一个星期后，我接到学生的电话，有一场重要的手术等着我。我回到医院，进手术室的时候，我有点儿不舒服。我没有想太多，完成了那场手术。四个小时后，我从手术室出来，觉得越来越不舒服。我的学生给我做了检查，结果出来了，但学生看不懂，他把报告给我看。我发现有个数据很奇怪，自己也看不懂。这是新问题，是我以前没有遇到过的问题。我的同事们也没有遇到过这样的问题，他们都和我一起查这个问题。三天后，慢慢地，我明白了，这是一种新病，现在还没有能治好这种病的方法。我告诉了同事们我的发现，他们都难过极了。但其实我只说了一半，这种病除了不能治好，还能让人很快去世。我的生命只有一个月了。
    我回到家，不知道怎么告诉多多这件事，但聪明的多多还是从我身上发现了问题。她问我发生了什么，我把事情全部告诉了她。她又哭了，我的女儿，她真的太难了。
    “爸爸，你去沉睡吧。”多多在大哭后对我说。
    她的话不是问题，不需要我的回答。她要我去沉睡中心沉睡，等以后的医学家们找到治好这种病的方法，我再醒来，就能把病治好，就能再活下去。多多说这是最好的办法，我理解，但是我不愿意。
    “如果我去沉睡了，你就是一个人了。你一个人怎么过呢？”
    “我不是一个人，虽然你沉睡了，但你还活着。”
    多多说动了我，我同意了，选择听她的话去沉睡。
fullText.traditional:
二、我要去沉睡了

    多多二十七歲的這一年——其實就是今年，阿樂離開了我們。那天早上，阿樂坐空中飛車去學校，但空中飛車的數據庫發生問題，兩個空中飛車在空中相撞了。兩個飛車上共有七個人，這七人和相撞的飛車同時從高空掉下，有三人因為傷太重去世了。這三人裡有阿樂。阿樂去世後的那個星期，我每天都在家照顧多多，因為多多太難過了。
    一個星期後，我接到學生的電話，有一場重要的手術等著我。我回到醫院，進手術室的時候，我有點兒不舒服。我沒有想太多，完成了那場手術。四個小時後，我從手術室出來，覺得越來越不舒服。我的學生給我做了檢查，結果出來了，但學生看不懂，他把報告給我看。我發現有個數據很奇怪，自己也看不懂。這是新問題，是我以前沒有遇到過的問題。我的同事們也沒有遇到過這樣的問題，他們都和我一起查這個問題。三天後，慢慢地，我明白了，這是一種新病，現在還沒有能治好這種病的方法。我告訴了同事們我的發現，他們都難過極了。但其實我只說了一半，這種病除了不能治好，還能讓人很快去世。我的生命只有一個月了。
    我回到家，不知道怎麼告訴多多這件事，但聰明的多多還是從我身上發現了問題。她問我發生了什麼，我把事情全部告訴了她。她又哭了，我的女兒，她真的太難了。
    “爸爸，你去沉睡吧。”多多在大哭後對我說。
    她的話不是問題，不需要我的回答。她要我去沉睡中心沉睡，等以後的醫學家們找到治好這種病的方法，我再醒來，就能把病治好，就能再活下去。多多說這是最好的辦法，我理解，但是我不願意。
    “如果我去沉睡了，你就是一個人了。你一個人怎麼過呢？”
    “我不是一個人，雖然你沉睡了，但你還活著。”
    多多說動了我，我同意了，選擇聽她的話去沉睡。

sentences.simplified: 多多二十七岁的这一年——其实就是今年，阿乐离开了我们。
sentences.traditional: 多多二十七歲的這一年——其實就是今年，阿樂離開了我們。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō èr shí qī suì de zhè yì nián qí shí jiù shì jīn nián ā yuè lí kāi le wǒ men
sentences.english: In the year when Duoduo was 27—actually, that’s this year, Ah Yue left us.

sentences.simplified: 那天早上，阿乐坐空中飞车去学校，
sentences.traditional: 那天早上，阿樂坐空中飛車去學校，
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān zǎo shang ā yuè zuò kōng zhōng fēi chē qù xué xiào
sentences.english: That morning, Ah Yue took a flying car to school.

sentences.simplified: 但空中飞车的数据库发生问题，两个空中飞车在空中相撞了。
sentences.traditional: 但空中飛車的數據庫發生問題，兩個空中飛車在空中相撞了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn kōng zhōng fēi chē de shù jù kù fā shēng wèn tí liǎng ge kōng zhōng fēi chē zài kōng zhōng xiāng zhuàng le
sentences.english: However, there was a problem with the flying car database, and two flying cars collided in the air.

sentences.simplified: 两个飞车上共有七个人，
sentences.traditional: 兩個飛車上共有七個人，
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge fēi chē shang gòng yǒu qī ge rén
sentences.english: There were seven people in total in the two flying cars.

sentences.simplified: 这七人和相撞的飞车同时从高空掉下，有三人因为伤太重去世了。
sentences.traditional: 這七人和相撞的飛車同時從高空掉下，有三人因為傷太重去世了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè qī rén hé xiāng zhuàng de fēi chē tóng shí cóng gāo kōng diào xià yǒu sān rén yīn wèi shāng tài zhòng qù shì le
sentences.english: The seven people and the colliding flying cars simultaneously fell from the sky. Three people died due to serious injuries.

sentences.simplified: 这三人里有阿乐。
sentences.traditional: 這三人裡有阿樂。
sentences.pinyin: zhè sān rén lǐ yǒu ā yuè
sentences.english: Ah Yue was among these three people.

sentences.simplified: 阿乐去世后的那个星期，我每天都在家照顾多多，因为多多太难过了。
sentences.traditional: 阿樂去世後的那個星期，我每天都在家照顧多多，因為多多太難過了。
sentences.pinyin: ā yuè qù shì hòu de nà ge xīng qī wǒ měi tiān dōu zài jiā zhào gù duō duō yīn wèi duō duō tài nán guò le
sentences.english: The week that Ah Yue passed away, I stayed at home each day to take care of Duoduo because she was so sad.

sentences.simplified: 一个星期后，我接到学生的电话，有一场重要的手术等着我。
sentences.traditional: 一個星期後，我接到學生的電話，有一場重要的手術等著我。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge xīng qī hòu wǒ jiē dào xué sheng de diàn huà yǒu yì cháng zhòng yào de shǒu shù děng zhe wǒ
sentences.english: A week later, I received a call from my student saying that an important surgery was waiting for me.

sentences.simplified: 我回到医院，进手术室的时候，我有点儿不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 我回到醫院，進手術室的時候，我有點兒不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huí dào yī yuàn jìn shǒu shù shì de shí hou wǒ yǒu diǎn'r bù shū fu
sentences.english: I went back to the hospital. When I went into the operating room, I felt a little unwell.

sentences.simplified: 我没有想太多，完成了那场手术。
sentences.traditional: 我沒有想太多，完成了那場手術。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu xiǎng tài duō wán chéng le nà cháng shǒu shù
sentences.english: I didn’t think too much about it, and went through with the surgery.

sentences.simplified: 四个小时后，我从手术室出来，觉得越来越不舒服。
sentences.traditional: 四個小時後，我從手術室出來，覺得越來越不舒服。
sentences.pinyin: sì ge xiǎo shí hòu wǒ cóng shǒu shù shì chū lái jué de yuè lái yuè bù shū fu
sentences.english: Four hours later, I emerged from the operating room, feeling increasingly unwell.

sentences.simplified: 我的学生给我做了检查，结果出来了，但学生看不懂，他把报告给我看。
sentences.traditional: 我的學生給我做了檢查，結果出來了，但學生看不懂，他把報告給我看。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de xué sheng gěi wǒ zuò le jiǎn chá jié guǒ chū lái le dàn xué sheng kàn bù dǒng tā bǎ bào gào gěi wǒ kàn
sentences.english: My student gave me an examination. The results came out, but the student couldn’t understand them, so he showed me the report.

sentences.simplified: 我发现有个数据很奇怪，自己也看不懂。
sentences.traditional: 我發現有個數據很奇怪，自己也看不懂。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ fā xiàn yǒu ge shù jù hěn qí guài zì jǐ yě kàn bù dǒng
sentences.english: I found some data that was very strange. I couldn’t understand it either.

sentences.simplified: 这是新问题，是我以前没有遇到过的问题。
sentences.traditional: 這是新問題，是我以前沒有遇到過的問題。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì xīn wèn tí shì wǒ yǐ qián méi yǒu yù dào guò de wèn tí
sentences.english: This was a new problem. This was a problem I hadn’t encountered before.

sentences.simplified: 我的同事们也没有遇到过这样的问题，他们都和我一起查这个问题。
sentences.traditional: 我的同事們也沒有遇到過這樣的問題，他們都和我一起查這個問題。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de tóng shì men yě méi yǒu yù dào guò zhè yàng de wèn tí tā men dōu hé wǒ yì qǐ chá zhè ge wèn tí
sentences.english: My colleagues hadn’t encountered such a problem before either. They all investigated this problem with me.

sentences.simplified: 三天后，慢慢地，我明白了，这是一种新病，现在还没有能治好这种病的方法。
sentences.traditional: 三天後，慢慢地，我明白了，這是一種新病，現在還沒有能治好這種病的方法。
sentences.pinyin: sān tiān hòu màn man de wǒ míng bai le zhè shì yì zhǒng xīn bìng xiàn zài hái méi yǒu néng zhì hǎo zhè zhǒng bìng de fāng fǎ
sentences.english: Three days later, gradually, I understood that this was a new illness, and there was currently no cure for it.

sentences.simplified: 我告诉了同事们我的发现，他们都难过极了。
sentences.traditional: 我告訴了同事們我的發現，他們都難過極了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ gào su le tóng shì men wǒ de fā xiàn tā men dōu nán guò jí le
sentences.english: I told my colleagues about my discovery. They were all extremely sad.

sentences.simplified: 但其实我只说了一半，这种病除了不能治好，还能让人很快去世。
sentences.traditional: 但其實我只說了一半，這種病除了不能治好，還能讓人很快去世。
sentences.pinyin: dàn qí shí wǒ zhǐ shuō le yí bàn zhè zhǒng bìng chú le bù néng zhì hǎo hái néng ràng rén hěn kuài qù shì
sentences.english: But actually, I only mentioned half of it. Besides being incurable, this illness can also cause a person to die quickly.

sentences.simplified: 我的生命只有一个月了。
sentences.traditional: 我的生命只有一個月了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de shēng mìng zhǐ yǒu yí ge yuè le
sentences.english: I only had one month left to live.

sentences.simplified: 我回到家，不知道怎么告诉多多这件事，但聪明的多多还是从我身上发现了问题。
sentences.traditional: 我回到家，不知道怎麼告訴多多這件事，但聰明的多多還是從我身上發現了問題。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huí dào jiā bù zhī dào zěn me gào su duō duō zhè jiàn shì dàn cōng ming de duō duō hái shi cóng wǒ shēn shang fā xiàn le wèn tí
sentences.english: I returned home, unsure of how to tell Duoduo about this, but clever Duoduo still noticed something was wrong with me.

sentences.simplified: 她问我发生了什么，我把事情全部告诉了她。
sentences.traditional: 她問我發生了什麼，我把事情全部告訴了她。
sentences.pinyin: tā wèn wǒ fā shēng le shén me wǒ bǎ shì qing quán bù gào su le tā
sentences.english: She asked me what happened, and I told her everything.

sentences.simplified: 她又哭了，我的女儿，她真的太难了。
sentences.traditional: 她又哭了，我的女兒，她真的太難了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu kū le wǒ de nǚ ér tā zhēn de tài nán le
sentences.english: She cried again. My daughter, she really was so sad.

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，你去沉睡吧。”多多在大哭后对我说。
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，你去沉睡吧。”多多在大哭後對我說。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba nǐ qù chén shuì ba duō duō zài dà kū hòu duì wǒ shuō
sentences.english: “Dad, go into deep sleep,” Duoduo said to me after crying a lot.

sentences.simplified: 她的话不是问题，不需要我的回答。
sentences.traditional: 她的話不是問題，不需要我的回答。
sentences.pinyin: tā de huà bú shì wèn tí bù xū yào wǒ de huí dá
sentences.english: Her words were not a question, and did not require my answer.

sentences.simplified: 她要我去沉睡中心沉睡，
sentences.traditional: 她要我去沉睡中心沉睡，
sentences.pinyin: tā yào wǒ qù chén shuì zhōng xīn chén shuì
sentences.english: She wanted me to go to a deep sleep center to enter deep sleep.

sentences.simplified: 等以后的医学家们找到治好这种病的方法，我再醒来，就能把病治好，就能再活下去。
sentences.traditional: 等以後的醫學家們找到治好這種病的方法，我再醒來，就能把病治好，就能再活下去。
sentences.pinyin: děng yǐ hòu de yī xué jiā men zhǎo dào zhì hǎo zhè zhǒng bìng de fāng fǎ wǒ zài xǐng lái jiù néng bǎ bìng zhì hǎo jiù néng zài huó xià qù
sentences.english: When future medical scientists find a cure for this disease, I can wake up, be cured, and continue to live.

sentences.simplified: 多多说这是最好的办法，我理解，但是我不愿意。
sentences.traditional: 多多說這是最好的辦法，我理解，但是我不願意。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō shuō zhè shì zuì hǎo de bàn fǎ wǒ lǐ jiě dàn shì wǒ bú yuàn yì
sentences.english: Duoduo said this was the best method. I understood, but I didn’t want to do it.

sentences.simplified: “如果我去沉睡了，你就是一个人了。你一个人怎么过呢？”
sentences.traditional: “如果我去沉睡了，你就是一個人了。你一個人怎麼過呢？”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ wǒ qù chén shuì le nǐ jiù shì yí ge rén le nǐ yí ge rén zěn me guò ne
sentences.english: “If I go into deep sleep, you’ll be alone. How will you survive alone?”

sentences.simplified: “我不是一个人，虽然你沉睡了，但你还活着。”
sentences.traditional: “我不是一個人，雖然你沉睡了，但你還活著。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù shì yí ge rén suī rán nǐ chén shuì le dàn nǐ hái huó zhe
sentences.english: “I won’t be alone. Although you will be in deep sleep, you will still be alive.”

sentences.simplified: 多多说动了我，我同意了，选择听她的话去沉睡。
sentences.traditional: 多多說動了我，我同意了，選擇聽她的話去沉睡。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō shuō dòng le wǒ wǒ tóng yì le xuǎn zé tīng tā de huà qù chén shuì
sentences.english: Duoduo convinced me and I agreed. I chose to listen to her and go into deep sleep.

sentence_translations: (2) I Must Go Into Deep Sleep
In the year when Duoduo was 27—actually, that’s this year, Ah Yue left us.
That morning, Ah Yue took a flying car to school.
However, there was a problem with the flying car database, and two flying cars collided in the air.
There were seven people in total in the two flying cars.
The seven people and the colliding flying cars simultaneously fell from the sky. Three people died due to serious injuries.
Ah Yue was among these three people.
The week that Ah Yue passed away, I stayed at home each day to take care of Duoduo because she was so sad.
A week later, I received a call from my student saying that an important surgery was waiting for me.
I went back to the hospital. When I went into the operating room, I felt a little unwell.
I didn’t think too much about it, and went through with the surgery.
Four hours later, I emerged from the operating room, feeling increasingly unwell.
My student gave me an examination. The results came out, but the student couldn’t understand them, so he showed me the report.
I found some data that was very strange. I couldn’t understand it either.
This was a new problem. This was a problem I hadn’t encountered before.
My colleagues hadn’t encountered such a problem before either. They all investigated this problem with me.
Three days later, gradually, I understood that this was a new illness, and there was currently no cure for it.
I told my colleagues about my discovery. They were all extremely sad.
But actually, I only mentioned half of it. Besides being incurable, this illness can also cause a person to die quickly.
I only had one month left to live.
I returned home, unsure of how to tell Duoduo about this, but clever Duoduo still noticed something was wrong with me.
She asked me what happened, and I told her everything.
She cried again. My daughter, she really was so sad.
“Dad, go into deep sleep,” Duoduo said to me after crying a lot.
Her words were not a question, and did not require my answer.
She wanted me to go to a deep sleep center to enter deep sleep.
When future medical scientists find a cure for this disease, I can wake up, be cured, and continue to live.
Duoduo said this was the best method. I understood, but I didn’t want to do it.
“If I go into deep sleep, you’ll be alone. How will you survive alone?”
“I won’t be alone. Although you will be in deep sleep, you will still be alive.”
Duoduo convinced me and I agreed. I chose to listen to her and go into deep sleep.
